question: In the Baltimore City Employees' Retirement Systems (BCERS) RFP for an alternatives consultant, how many years must the proposing firm have been in business?
expected_facts: At least seven (7) years providing general consulting services plus private equity consulting services, or alternatives consulting services only (all minimum qualifications must be met as of November 8, 2024, 3:00 p.m. EDT).
acceptance: Seven years is sufficient for the narrow question. Service type and qualification deadline are optional; five-year staff experience is not the firm threshold.
